business.what_it_does: Company manufactures and sells food products, milk products, nutrition, prepared dishes, cooking aids, powdered and liquid beverages, and confectionery items.

segments.name: Milk Products and Nutrition
segments.what: Sells dairy whitener, condensed milk, UHT milk, yogurt, and baby foods.

segments.name: Prepared Dishes and Cooking Aids
segments.what: Sells noodles, sauces, seasonings, pasta, cereals, and pet food.

segments.name: Powdered and Liquid Beverages
segments.what: Sells instant coffee, instant tea, and ready to drink beverages.

segments.name: Confectionery
segments.what: Sells bar countlines, tablets, and sugar confectionery.

business.mix_note: No single customer accounts for more than 10% of the Company's revenue.

promise_ledger.promise: Deliver and maintain margin in line with past track record
promise_ledger.delivered: Medium-term target; Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin reached 24.0%, matching historical annual levels of 23.0%-24.0%.
promise_ledger.quote: we are not chasing growth at the cost of margin. We will deliver and maintain our margin in line with our past track record.

credibility.line: None of these promises can be checked against reported numbers yet — no score.

narrative_vs_numbers.point: Management claims 20 quarters of double-digit NESCAFÉ growth, but segment performance is not detailed in reported financials.
Management cited premium portfolio expansion to 14%, but quarterly product mix figures are not disclosed in financial statements.
Despite analyst concerns on ad spend, Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin held steady at 24.0% with revenue up 20.3% YoY.

bull: Q2 FY27 revenue grew 20.3% YoY to ₹6,788.0 crore while EBITDA margin held at 24.0%.
Cash conversion is strong with Mar 2026 OCF/PAT at 1.44 and 5-year conversion at 1.25.
Company is virtually debt-free with D/E of 0.08 and equity of ₹5,777.0 crore in Sep 2026.
bear: EBIT margin contracted from 23.2% in Mar 2026 to 20.7% in Sep 2026.
Analysts raised concerns over sustainability of double-digit volume growth and milk category challenges.
Free cash flow saw extreme volatility, dropping to ₹932.0 crore in Mar 2025 before Mar 2026 recovery.
watch: EBITDA margin holding at the historical 23.0%-24.0% level.
Sustainability of revenue growth after 20.3% YoY in Sep 2026.
Ad spend impact on quarterly EBIT margins.
